newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures consolidate for new rise.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures consolidate for new rise.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures settled almost unchanged on Wednesday with dealers saying the market appeared to be getting ready for a rise.
"The market is consolidating," said a local dealer. "On the charts, it looks good with some upside possible."
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract closed 10 points up at 21,485 on a very low 7,800 lots.
The contract swung through a 120-point range during the day with most dealers focusing on the approaching Japanese general election, scheduled for October 20.
But most dealers said they were relatively bullish on the prospects for the index with Japanese economy recovering and a weaker yen underpinning the country's industrial performance.
They thought the Nikkei was likely to break up, rather than down, when it finally moved out of its current range between 21,300 and 21,800.
"If December closes on the weekly charts above 21,780 points, it could go higher. But if it drops below 21,250/300, then we could see a fall," said a chart analyst.
